assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: opaque bitmap material for worn yellow painted metal game UI plates, wide horizontal 3:1 composition, full bleed, orthographic.
Input images: Image 1 is the current yellow paint EDIT TARGET and palette authority. Image 2 is a REFERENCE for physical material depth and lighting. Image 3 is a STYLE REFERENCE for the Void Strike atompunk interface.
Primary request: rework the overly clean yellow paint into visibly aged, tactile painted steel that belongs beside image 2. Generate ONLY a continuous material surface, with no plate outline or frame.
Keep: saturated warm industrial yellow around #ffc20f / #f6b709, opaque paint, high readability for dark lettering over the surface. No text or symbols.
Wear: irregular chipped paint with tiny lifted yellow lips, restrained upper-left highlights and dark contact shadows below-right; deep brown-black pitted steel and sparse burnt-sienna rust visible inside chips; fine worn silver scrape marks, scuffed lacquer and ingrained amber-grey grime. Wear should read clearly when this asset is displayed on a button 400px wide, rather than shrinking to invisible black dots.
Distribution: roughly 75–80% remains yellow; exposed metal and oxide take about 10–15%, the rest subtle scratches and yellow-toned grime. The central text area remains mostly yellow but has fine tactile grain and occasional small abrasions. Damage is asymmetric, naturally clustered and varied, not uniform speckling. Include worn patches a little way INSIDE the surface because CSS crops the source for different button shapes. Small chips mainly 3–12px wide when displayed at 400px; occasional 12–22px clusters toward outer regions, no single huge patch.
Lighting: consistent soft upper-left grazing light matching image 2, matte baked material shading.
Constraints: no screws, no bolts, no border, no bevel around the canvas, no rounded rectangular object silhouette, no text, no icons, no warning stripes. No broad gradient, no spotlight, no vignette, no blurred clouds, no glossy wet sheen, no giant rust blobs, no holes through the material. Full bleed opaque texture. Preserve a clear yellow visual identity.
Variant A: chipped paint clusters loosely run along short upper and lower bands, several small irregular worn islands on the left, fine directional scuffs toward the right; centre has restrained pitting and short thin scratches. Strong but controlled aged paint.
